focus: Overrides used to replace whole top-level sections, so overriding db.host also dropped db.port. Merge nested dicts key by key instead. Any non-dict override still replaces the value. load() is called once per deployment, and DEFAULTS must never change.

bug.what: dict(base) is a shallow copy, so result[key].update() changes the nested dicts inside DEFAULTS and one deployment's overrides leak into the next load().
